error.signature: AI tells a foreigner in Portugal to contact SEF (Servico de Estrangeiros e Fronteiras), book a SEF appointment, or check sef.pt for a residence-permit renewal or visa follow-up
error.regex: (sef\.pt|sef appointment|servi[cç]o de estrangeiros e fronteiras|contact sef)

verdict.summary: SEF (Servico de Estrangeiros e Fronteiras) was abolished at 00:00 on 29 October 2023 under Decreto-Lei n.o 41/2023, of 2 June. Its administrative functions for foreigners - residence-permit issuance and renewal, visa follow-up, and related appointments - transferred to the newly created Agencia para a Integracao, Migracoes e Asilo (AIMA, I.P.). Border-control duties did not go to AIMA: air-border control went to the PSP and land/maritime border control went to the GNR. An AI trained before late 2023, or simply reciting older material, will confidently point users to an agency that no longer exists.

dead_ends.action: Tell a foreigner to book a SEF appointment, visit sef.pt, or wait for a SEF-issued residence-card renewal
dead_ends.why_fails: Decreto-Lei n.o 41/2023 created AIMA, I.P. as the successor to SEF for administrative matters concerning foreign citizens, and SEF was abolished when AIMA began operating on 29 October 2023; SEF no longer processes appointments or renewals.
dead_ends.condition: Any residence-permit, visa, or immigration appointment topic after October 2023
dead_ends.common_misconception: That SEF still exists as Portugal's immigration authority, since it operated under that name for decades.

dead_ends.action: Assume AIMA also handles airport passport checks or other border-control duties that used to belong to SEF
dead_ends.why_fails: Decreto-Lei n.o 41/2023 split SEF's old law-enforcement duties away from its administrative ones: air-border control went to the PSP and land/maritime border control went to the GNR, while AIMA took only the administrative-integration functions (residence permits, asylum, integration policy).

workarounds.action: Direct users to AIMA (Agencia para a Integracao, Migracoes e Asilo) for residence-permit renewals, visa follow-up, and appointment scheduling - not SEF
For airport or border-crossing questions, point to the PSP (air border) or GNR (land/maritime border) rather than an immigration-specific agency

frequently_confused_with.distinction: AIMA handles immigration status (residence permits, visas); NIF is a separate tax-registration number from the Autoridade Tributaria needed for banking, leases, and contracts.
